<observation>
PLAN.md (32 lines, 1584 bytes)
 1: # Quillmark — the spec
 2: 
 3: A dependency-free Markdown → static-site generator. CommonJS, Node ≥ 18, no
 4: dependencies, no CDN, no build tooling. Everything is plain files.
 5: 
 6: ## The shape
 7: 
 8: ```
 9: package.json          "test": "node test/run.js", bin -> src/cli.js
10: src/markdown.js       parses front-matter + markdown into a document tree
11: src/render.js         renders a document tree into one HTML page
12: src/cli.js            the CLI: quillmark <input.md> [-o out.html] [--title T]
13: test/run.js           the test runner + assertions (no dependencies)
14: docs/USAGE.md         how to use the CLI and the module API
15: site/index.md         a sample page the CLI renders into site/index.html
16: ```
17: 
18: ## The rules
19: 
20: 1. **Front matter** — a document may start with `---` fenced YAML-ish metadata
21:    (`title:`, `tags:`). The parser reads it, strips it, and keeps the pairs.
22: 2. **Markdown** — headings (`#`..`######`), paragraphs, unordered lists
23:    (`- item`), ordered lists (`1. item`), fenced code blocks (```), inline code
24:    (`` `code` ``), bold (`**x**`), italic (`*x*`) and links (`[text](url)`).
25: 3. **Rendering** — one self-contained HTML file per document: inline CSS, no
26:    external assets, `<title>` from the front matter or the first heading.
27: 4. **The CLI** — `node src/cli.js <input.md> [-o <out.html>] [--title <title>]`
28:    prints the rendered HTML (or writes it to the file), exits 0 on success and
29:    non-zero when the input file is missing.
30: 5. **Tests** — `npm test` runs `node test/run.js`, which asserts the parser and
31:    the renderer and exits non-zero on the first failure.
32:
